reset_settings_confirm: Reset all preferences, including native appearance, proxy, saved directory authorization, music index and window position? Download history and music files will be kept. The app will exit; reopen it to apply the reset.
reset_all_confirm: Reset all preferences, clear all application data and download history, and sign out? Music files will be kept. The app will exit; reopen it to apply the reset.
reset_native_failed: The native reset request was not confirmed. This page has not started clearing data. Retry; a saved request will resume when the app is reopened.
reset_renderer_failed: Native preference reset is scheduled, but application data could not be fully cleared. The app will exit. Check and retry after reopening it.
reset_quit_failed: Preference reset is scheduled, but the app could not exit automatically. Please quit and reopen it manually. Also check any earlier application data clearing error.
reset_scheduled: Preference reset is scheduled. The app will exit; reopen it to apply the reset.
reset_recovery_failed: Preference reset is pending. Previous settings have not been loaded. Retry, or quit and reopen the app.
reset_restart_before_recovery: Reset is scheduled. Quit the app completely and reopen it.
